name: Femboy : Rescue Mission
source: Take charge as a lifeguard dispatcher! Manage emergencies, guide rescue teams, and build relationships with a charming femboy recruit and a carefree veteran lifeguard in this summer romance story.
translation: 出任救生员调度主管，挑起大梁吧！在这部夏日恋爱物语中应对突发险情、指挥救援小队，并与迷人的伪娘新兵及潇洒随性的资深救生员培养深厚感情。
